basic_info.description: Glen Park Opportunity with Views & Vision! 165 Burnside Avenue is a rare offering perched atop a quiet Glen Park cul-de-sac street with sweeping panoramic views.  The main level features 3BR's, 1BA, LR, DR, and Kitchen. The lower level offers a 1-car garage and the ideal canvas for your vision and creativity to expand the foot print.    The deep backyard is a hidden gem, terraced, and bursting with possibilities for expansion, entertaining, or creating your dream garden retreat. Located minutes from parks, shopping, Glen Park Village, Muni, BART, and tech shuttle stops, this home offers the best of both tranquility and convenience.
